# Conventional Commits

Every commit subject line follows [Conventional Commits 1.0](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/). PR titles match the commit subject (squash-merge preserves the PR title as the merged commit subject).

## Format

```text
<type>(<scope>): <imperative-mood subject, lowercase, no period>

<body paragraph(s) explaining the why>

Cite: <standard citation, see always-cite-standards rule>
Trace: <docs/traceability.csv row id>
Closes: #<issue>
```

## Allowed types

| type | use for |
| --- | --- |
| `feat` | New feature |
| `fix` | Bug fix |
| `chore` | Maintenance / housekeeping |
| `docs` | Documentation only |
| `ci` | CI / build pipeline |
| `refactor` | Behaviour-preserving refactor |
| `test` | Tests added or changed |
| `perf` | Performance improvement |
| `build` | Build system / toolchain |
| `revert` | Revert a prior commit |

## Allowed scopes

`master`, `slave`, `transport`, `profile-marine`, `profile-space`, `docs`, `ci`, `standards`, `scaffold`, `rules`, `issues`, `runbook`, `research`, `status-sync`, `release`.

Match the `area/*` labels (parent plan Â§6.6). New scopes require a single-line update to this rule + the matching label.

## Examples

```text
feat(slave): implement CONNECT command per XCP 1.4 Â§1.3.2.4
fix(master): correct CTR wrap-around in DAQ_GAP detection
chore(rules): cursor rule set + agent mirrors + parent-plan status-sync
docs(research): system requirements + packet-loss tolerance budget
ci(misra-gate): add cppcheck addon=misra runner
test(slave/transport): conformance suite row 1-7 (loss + reorder)
```

## CI enforcement (lands in PR-4)

`pr-title.yml` workflow runs [`amannn/action-semantic-pull-request`](https://github.com/amannn/action-semantic-pull-request) (pinned to commit SHA per `version-pinning` rule) configured with the type + scope lists above. PR title regression blocks merge.
